Alignment Along the Main Axis (Justify Content)"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'justify-*' utilities control how flex items are distributed along the main axis (horizontal by default in 'flex-row')."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"justify-start: Packs items toward the start of the container."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"justify-center: Centers items along the main axis."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"justify-between: Distributes items evenly with the first item at the start and the last at the end."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"justify-around: Distributes items with equal space around them."},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"4. Alignment Along the Cross Axis (Align Items)"},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'items-*' utilities control how flex items are positioned along the cross axis (vertical by default in 'flex-row')."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"items-start: Aligns items at the cross-start."},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":"items-center: Centers items vertically."},{"order":22,"type":"bullet_point","text":"items-stretch: Stretches items to fill the container height (default behavior)."},{"order":23,"type":"code","text":"
